description: SQL statements accepted by both the Rust SQL Document parser and the DataFusion parser used by the read-only executor.

cases.sql: SELECT g."Name" AS label FROM "tasks" AS g
SELECT CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(10, 2)), CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM "tasks"
SELECT "_ugoite_id" FROM "tasks" WHERE (amount >= $minimum OR amount IS NULL) AND "_ugoite_id" <> $excluded
SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS total FROM "tasks" GROUP BY category HAVING SUM(amount) > 0 ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20 OFFSET 5
SELECT a."_ugoite_id" FROM "tasks" AS a INNER JOIN "tasks" AS b ON a."_ugoite_id" = b."_ugoite_id"
SELECT a."_ugoite_id" FROM "tasks" AS a CROSS JOIN "tasks" AS b
SELECT a."_ugoite_id" FROM "tasks" AS a JOIN "tasks" AS b USING ("_ugoite_id")
SELECT nested."_ugoite_id" FROM (SELECT "_ugoite_id" FROM "tasks") AS nested
WITH source_rows AS (SELECT "_ugoite_id" FROM "tasks") SELECT "_ugoite_id" FROM source_rows WHERE "_ugoite_id" IN (SELECT "_ugoite_id" FROM "tasks")
SELECT 1 AS value UNION BY NAME SELECT 2 AS value
